title: Solar System: The 8 Planets
welcome_lead: Meet the family — eight planets and one star, all bound by gravity.
meta_desc: KS3 astronomy: 8 planets, rocky vs gas, order from the Sun.
final_note: From Mercury to Neptune, each planet has its own story.

walkthroughs.body_html: From the Sun outward: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune. The first four are rocky; the last four are giants.
Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars are small, dense and made of rock and metal. They sit closer to the Sun's warmth.
Jupiter and Saturn are gas giants; Uranus and Neptune are ice giants. They are huge and surrounded by rings and many moons.
